build_model(model_cfg, n_models,
query_dim, profile_dim)
picks class by model_cfg['orientation']
(default: query_latent)

NIRTModel (orientation=query_latent)
PRIMARY -- this project's own/default
theta_q = query_head(e_q)

latent_query(e_q) -> theta_q
Linear or MLP head (query_head)
optional BatchNorm whitening (P7b)

Model side (a_m, b_m)
EITHER free: nn.Embedding(n_models,dim)
(transductive -- can't score unseen model)
OR projected: a_head/b_head MLP-or-Linear
on profile e_m (cold-start capable)

score(theta,a,b) -> logit
scalar: logit = a_m . theta_q - b_m
vector: logit = sum_k a_mk(theta_qk-b_mk)
+ optional interaction residual (P2c),
gamma init 0
y_hat = sigmoid(logit)  (predict_proba)

center_discrimination (optional)
_center_discrimination /
set_discrimination_reference
subtracts pool-mean a_ref from every a_m
-- lossless for within-query ranking

IRTRouterModel (orientation=model_latent)
ALTERNATE / comparison only
(IRT-Router paper, Song et al. ACL'25)
theta_m=[sigmoid] theta_head(e_m)
a_q,b_q = a_head(e_q), b_head(e_q)
logit = a_q . theta_m - b_q
